ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 10:90 ratio of high-intensity (white/tan) pixels to low-intensity (dark gray/black) pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-contrast textured clusters located at the distal tips of both lobes. Sparse, isolated circular high-intensity blobs (mottling) distributed across the central and lower regions of the fluke blades.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with a measured pixel angle of approximately 65 degrees and a high depth-to-width ratio within the bounding area.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serration along the trailing edge with pixel-amplitude variations forming irregular peaks and valleys, ranging from 5 to 20 pixels in depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Sigmoidal curve on the trailing edges; the left lobe displays a more pronounced upward convex sweep compared to the right lobe's flatter trajectory.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of irregular circular pixel patterns (barnacle colonies) on distal tips. Scattered individual circular white focal points across the mid-section of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, light-gray linear pixel disruptions visible on the right lobe, primarily oriented diagonally from the leading edge toward the notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive sessile barnacle colonization (Coronula diadema) concentrated on the fluke tips; multiple circular depigmented scars distributed across the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: The extreme distal edges of both lobes exhibit significant three-dimensional textural deformity due to dense biological accumulation, altering the expected planar contour.
